statement: For every finite family of smooth compactly supported densities ϕ1, . . . , ϕm of integral zero, the vector ⟨hδ, ϕi⟩  i converges jointly in law and in every joint moment to the corresponding pairings of Hκ. The moment convergence is uniform when the tests vary in a compact smooth family with a common compact support.
